entities.name: RRC Connection Release
entities.description: Procedure to release the RRC connection, including release of established radio bearers (except broadcast MRBs), BH RLC channels, Uu Relay RLC channels, and all radio resources.

entities.name: RRC Connection Suspend
entities.description: Procedure to suspend the RRC connection when SRB2 and at least one DRB or multicast MRB (or for IAB, SRB2) are setup, which includes suspension of established radio bearers.

entities.name: RRCRelease
entities.description: Message sent from network to UE to initiate RRC connection release or suspension.

entities.name: Suspension Requirements
entities.description: Condition that SRB2 and at least one DRB or multicast MRB (or for IAB, SRB2) must be setup for RRC connection suspension to occur.

entities.name: Release Radio Resources
entities.description: Property that all radio bearers (except broadcast MRBs), BH RLC channels, Uu Relay RLC channels, and radio resources are released during RRC connection release.

entities.name: Suspend Radio Bearers
entities.description: Property that established radio bearers are suspended during RRC connection suspension.

relations.description: RRCRelease message triggers the RRC connection release procedure
RRCRelease message triggers the RRC connection suspension procedure
RRC connection suspension procedure requires that suspension conditions are met
RRC connection release procedure establishes the release of radio resources
RRC connection suspension procedure establishes the suspension of radio bearers
